source_identity.identity_join_rule: Exact source path/blob plus one of the explicit source-local candidate ids above only; no title, label, fuzzy or semantic join.

public_primary_support.source: de Rooij and van Erven, Learning the Switching Rate by Discretising Bernoulli Sources Online, AISTATS 2009
public_primary_support.finding: The Fixed-Share HMM used for the audited coding term has uniform initial expert prior, stay probability 1-alpha and switch-to-each-other probability alpha/(J-1); the optimal fixed switching-rate bound uses alpha=(m-1)/(T-1).

public_primary_support.source: de Rooij, van Erven, Grunwald, Koolen, Follow the Leader If You Can, Hedge If You Must, JMLR 2014
public_primary_support.finding: For constant eta, mix loss m_t=-(1/eta)log(w_t dot exp(-eta l_t)), delta_t=h_t-m_t and cumulative regret decomposes into mix-loss regret plus cumulative mixability gap Delta. This is the exact ingredient used by r114a.

public_primary_support.source: Borsos, Curi, Levy, Krause, Online Variance Reduction with Mixtures, ICML 2019
public_primary_support.finding: Published work independently supports adaptive mixture-weight optimization for variance reduction, but it is not a reproduction of the r114 rare-event simulator or its Fixed-Share certificate.

theory_constants_reconstructed.status: Matches the source certificate to floating-point precision.

finite_horizon_structural_reproduction.status: Exact HMM partition/mix-loss equality and the pathwise C/eta+Delta certificate reproduce independently on an unrelated bounded-loss sequence. This validates the structural theorem, not the worker's rare-event performance run.

source_aggregate_arithmetic.status: Reported aggregate arithmetic is internally consistent. Quantiles and paired standard errors cannot be independently regenerated without raw run outputs.

implementation_parameterization_caveat.finding: Fixed Share has multiple common share conventions. The audited theorem/coding term is the switch-away HMM convention: stay=1-alpha and each other expert gets alpha/(J-1). A public independent implementation, Dralliag/opera R/fixedshare.R at commit 24070db124c14df022c9356a3b517599ffd95148, instead updates v to (1-alpha)*v + alpha/J. With the same numeric alpha these are not the same Markov prior.
implementation_parameterization_caveat.reproducibility_consequence: A replay must freeze the share convention, not only the scalar alpha. The r114 certificate fixes the theoretical convention, but no source simulation code is persisted, so the convention actually used to generate r114c/r114d numerical performance cannot be independently read back.

exact_replay_gaps: No runnable r114 simulation program is persisted with the certificate.
No RNG seed or raw 300-replicate recurring-drift outputs are persisted.
No RNG seed or raw 1000-replicate ex-post-certificate outputs are persisted.

The r112/r113 lineage specifies the 4096-branch distributional form but not the realized z_i vector, proxy-noise realization, common-random streams or immutable environment needed to reproduce the reported numbers exactly.
The Fixed-Share share convention used in the numerical simulator cannot be verified from a persisted implementation artifact.
No protocol-matched third-party reproduction or failure report for the r114 synthetic experiment was found.

candidate_level_assessment.cf-g1-r114a-fixed-share-exact-mixability: A. Independently derived from the published Fixed-Share HMM plus mixability-gap identity and mechanically reproduced by full path enumeration on a deterministic unrelated bounded-loss sequence, under the exact switch-away convention.
candidate_level_assessment.cf-g1-r114b-conservative-theorem-tuning-: A. The alpha, C, eta and 152.0251 variance-unit worst-case penalty are independently recalculated exactly; the conclusion that this is large relative to a roughly 185-200 unit horizon is arithmetic, not a new empirical claim.
candidate_level_assessment.cf-g1-r114c-aggressive-fixed-share-recur: C+. Aggregate arithmetic is consistent, but the 300-replicate performance result is source-run engineering evidence without runnable code, seeds, raw outputs or independently verified share convention.
candidate_level_assessment.cf-g1-r114d-realized-mixability-certific: B-/C+. The pathwise certificate is theoretically valid and reported means are internally consistent, but the claimed empirical distribution/quantiles over 1000 runs are not independently replayable from persisted artifacts.
candidate_level_assessment.cf-g1-r114e-parameter-free-controller-ne: C. It is correctly scoped as one synthetic implementation result, but the AdaNormalHedge.TV comparison lacks runnable source/run artifacts and cannot be independently reproduced here.

scope_conclusion: The r114a/r114b mathematical core is strongly reproducible under the explicitly audited switch-away Fixed-Share convention. The r114c/r114d/r114e numerical engineering claims remain source-run evidence rather than independently reproduced results. The strongest new reproducibility risk is implementation-convention ambiguity: common Fixed-Share code can interpret the same alpha differently, so a future replay bundle must persist the exact update code/convention together with seeds, latent branch scores/noise and raw replicate outputs.
reopen_conditions: A source-matched runnable r114 simulation plus immutable environment, exact Fixed-Share update implementation, seeds and raw 300/1000-run outputs is published.
A protocol-matched independent reproduction or failure report appears.
A persisted artifact identifies the exact share convention and latent/common-random inputs used for r114c/r114d/r114e.
The certificate-triggered eta-ladder/restart controller is implemented with a replayable theorem/run contract.
